scenario: controlled incomplete transaction: effects prepared while sealed, daemon interrupted before commit, then recovered
incomplete_state_detection: transaction stayed 'ready' with 2 prepared effects; earlier empty-patch variant produced 'needs_reconciliation' which futurediff recover resolved to 'ready' with 'all unresolved effects proved absent or remain prepared'
recovery_actions: futurediff recover <tx> -> needs_reconciliation to ready (effects proved absent)
repeated recovery safely refused (not recoverable when already ready)
resume via low-level commit with approved transaction_digest (canonical recovery command reported by the guided error)
recovery_guarantee: FutureDiff supports resume/retry and abort of incomplete transactions; it does not claim full rollback of an already-committed external effect. Incomplete transactions are detected (needs_reconciliation), reconciled to a safe state (effects proved absent -> ready; effects committed -> finalized), and retried exactly-once via idempotency keys and durable receipts.
redaction: no secrets captured; audit records contain no secrets
